title: Be used to и get used to

theory.md: **be used to + -ing** — привык, это нормально: I**'m used to getting** up early. **get used to + -ing** — привыкать: You'll **get used to** the heat. Не путать с **used to + глагол** — «раньше бывало»: I **used to live** in Leeds.

cells: I used to swim every day.
I'm used to working at night.
I'm getting used to the cold.

theory.md: После be/get used to — существительное или -ing: I'm used to **the noise**, I'm used to **driving** (а не «to drive»).

examples.es: I'm used to the heat now.
She isn't used to walking so much.
You'll soon get used to it.
I used to be afraid of the dark.

options: I'm used to getting up early.
I'm used to get up early.
I used to getting up early.
I used to live by the sea.
I'm used to living by the sea.
I used to living by the sea.

exercises.sentence: It's hard to get used to ___ in the desert.

exercises.ru: Не волнуйся, она к этому привыкла.
